To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we can systematically generate a glass-box test case for a given function by executing the function with uninstantiated arguments and that the generated test cases cover the control-flow of a program.

we have developed an approach to automatically generating glass-box test cases based on the narrowing mechanism of Curry that is able to handle laziness and that can be used to achieve control-flow coverage.
the test case generation for functional (logic) programs is possible and that the resulting test suites have good coverage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a tool that supports glass-box test case generation for functional logic programs.
the generation and evaluation of glass-box test suites for functional logic programs.
the development of techniques for automatic glass-box testing of functional logic programs, which are based on the narrowing-based execution of Curry programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is able to automatically generate a test case system for glass-box testing that is complete w.r.t. the coverage criterion under consideration.
the presented approach is not only useful in practice, but it can also serve as a benchmark for other approaches.
our method is a good basis for a tool to generate a system of glass-box test-cases for functional logic programs, but the method is still not mature enough to serve this purpose directly.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach is a generalization of existing work on glass-box testing of functional logic programs to a wider range of coverage criteria.
we have shown that the generation of test cases for Curry can be done in a systematic and efficient manner.
we have developed an approach for glass-box testing that works for functional logic programs and that is able to handle the peculiarities of functional logic programs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
glass-box test cases can be generated for a large class of programs in a fully automatic manner.
the test cases are generated in a fully automated fashion, i.e., no manual intervention of the programmer is required.
glass-box testing can be applied in the context of functional (logic) programs, and that it is even possible to automatically generate test cases for such programs.
